technicalNotes:
Airbag
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: an Airbag Kontrol Modülü, do not attempt to repair the Kontrol Modülü but Değiştirin / Yenileyin: it with a proper new Part instead. The Installation of used Airbag Components as well as repaired ones is explicitly forbidden by the Manufacturer Specifications found in the Factory Repair Manual. There are Companies offering the repair of Airbag Kontrol Modülüs which will violate said Manufacturer Specifications. Ross-Tech will not assist with the Installation of used or repaired Airbag Kontrol Modülüs.
